reviewer: Codex with one fresh GPT-6.1-Sol medium reviewer

claims.summary: For weak unary PHP with n+1 pigeons and n>=1 holes, original row violations and column collisions plus Boolean/commutator generators have a placeholder-linear noncommutative IPS formula of size O(n^8) and constant ordered unbounded-fan-in depth over K=F_(2^a), |K|=O(n^2). Compact row/column Laurent identities, paid sorting and coefficient z^-1 extraction over range [-L,L], L=4(n(n+1)+n+1), give the certificate. Coefficientwise trace gives a binary-coefficient certificate with a shallow K formula of size O(n^8 log(n+2)). No constant-depth F2 formula, small word ranks or extra row functionality is claimed.
claims.assessment: Working all-n Laurent construction, passed by the sole fresh GPT-6.1-Sol medium reviewer. The committed local and one-hole checker passed all written expectations; no shallow binary-formula or word-rank conclusion.
claims.rationale: Tests whether a growing-width integer-counting family escapes the shallow extension-field certificate mechanism; preserves the distinction from the binary lower-bound target.
claims.next_action: Retain binary and image-sensitive hardness questions, but do not infer shallow extension-field hardness for ordinary PHP from its PC degree or row width.

claims.summary: For binary old-variable formulas F_i of total size s/depth delta with no common Boolean zero, any supplied free-algebra IPS formula C for the full tuple, size S/depth d, transforms to D=H+PC, where P=ordered product(1-F_i) and H=sum_i ordered prefix(1-F_j)Y_i. D is a certificate of size O(S+(m+1)(s+m+1)), depth <=max(d,delta+3)+2, preserving placeholder-linearity. For every Boolean old point a, D(a,Y)=H(a,Y) even for noncommuting placeholders. This is ordered iterated axiom-cut normalization, not a certificate from nothing, formal coefficient fixation, exact-depth or matched-image preservation claim.
claims.assessment: Working ordered whole-cube consequence of the earlier axiom-cut identity, passed by the sole fresh GPT-6.1-Sol medium reviewer. This is a costed normalization of a supplied certificate, not a new refutation or exact-image result.
claims.rationale: Prevents a value-only hard-function argument from ignoring a costed normalization available to the general shallow certificate class.
claims.next_action: Any proposed extraction must inspect additional formal information or justify its exact simulation-image restriction; cheap Boolean values alone do not provide a certificate lower bound.

relationships: Uses the proved Laurent interpolation and coefficientwise trace mechanism, with new polynomial-size row/column certificates replacing bounded-arity enumeration.
Unlike the homogeneous-linear-factor Tseitin witness, this theorem does not claim low ranks for PHP word tensors.
Exactly its ordered iteration in reverse input order, flattened into explicit prefix products; records the whole-cube consequence in the noncommutative formula model.
Earlier commutative fixed-clause normalization already gives cheap cube values. Here formal clause coefficients are not fixed, and the statement covers noncommuting placeholders.
The older full Boolean-correction endpoint remains hard formally; vanishing of the residual on cube points is not its formal zero identity.
The general certificate class has this cheap normalization, but preservation of the exact prefix-simulation image is not asserted.
